technique_name: Combine the following two recipes to get a delicious meal.
description: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, stirring often. Add the garlic and red bell pepper and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring often. Serve hot.
example:
Recipe 1: 2 tablespoons olive oil, 1 onion chopped.
Recipe 2: 4 cloves garlic, 1 red bell pepper diced.
